newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS sees added earnings from restructuring.
newsitem.headline: UBS sees added earnings from restructuring.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland said it expected incremental earnings of around 200 million Swiss francs a year from a reorganisation of its Swiss domestic business.

"The measures approved will result in incremental earnings of around 200 million Swiss francs a year," chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta said in the text of the speech released before a news conference.
"The net present value of these future income flows is around 1.5 billion Swiss francs," he added.

Cabiallavetta said UBS expected to generate additional value-added of roughly the same magnitude in future, with further measures, in particular earnings improvements in the lending and retail sectors.
He said the additional measures to improve lending and retail earnings had been defined but not yet approved in detail.
